T:P1.2.text: Whether you’re looking for complete flow assurance, industrial heating, temperature maintenance, freeze protection or environmental monitoring, Thermon has you covered

T:P1.4.text: World Leader In Industrial Process Heating

T:P1.6.text: Learn from Thermon engineers and product experts. Explore live sessions, visit us at industry events, or watch on-demand.

T:P1.7.text: From electric heat tracing to explosion-proof heaters, Thermon delivers engineered thermal solutions across every industry and environment.

T:P1.8.text: Electric heat, immersion, circulation, and specialty heaters for every industrial application.

T:P1.9.text: Electrical heat tracing cables, steam trace products, controls, and monitoring systems.

T:P1.10.text: Explosion-proof and rugged heating solutions engineered for the harshest transportation environments.

T:P1.11.text: General purpose and hazardous location power distribution panels and accessories for project sites.

T:P1.12.text: Electrically heated, steam, and pre-insulated tubing bundles with complete system accessories.

T:P1.13.text: Precision thermal management solutions designed to protect critical data center infrastructure.

T:P1.14.text: Heated flat blankets and container temperature control for custom industrial heating needs.

T:P1.15.text: Steam, hot water, and electrode boilers plus ancillary equipment for precision thermal processes.

T:P1.16.text: High-performance steam, hot oil, and hot water boilers with superheaters and ancillary systems.

T:P1.17.text: Our customers rely on us to provide high quality, safe, reliable and environmentally responsible solutions for their heating needs.

T:P1.18.text: Whether you’re looking for complete flow assurance, industrial heating, temperature maintenance, freeze protection or environmental monitoring, Thermon has you covered.

T:P1.19.text: We proudly celebrate our 70th anniversary! Since our founding in by Richard Burdick, Thermon has been dedicated to innovation in heat transfer solutions.

T:P1.20.text: From introducing heat transfer cement to pioneering the first packaged tracing systems and developing high-performance heating technologies, we’ve consistently pushed the boundaries to meet our customers’ needs

C:P1.2.text: Powell Industries is an electrical engineering and manufacturing company based in Houston, TX, with operations across the U.S., Canada, and the U.K.

C:P1.3.text: We're with you every step of the way, from project inception to product delivery.

C:P1.4.text: Introducing the next evolution of our PowlVac Circuit Breaker, the Series 5. Effective, the Series 5 PowlVac will be our standard offering. Click on the link to learn more.

C:P1.5.text: Powell takes pride in listening to our customers, understanding their needs, and proposing innovative and cost-efficient solutions.

C:P1.6.text: Single-source supplier for project execution and delivery

C:P1.9.text: Safety is and always has been central to our beliefs and culture.

C:P1.11.text: We are dedicated to improving people’s lives by providing reliable power distribution systems in every market we serve. From industrial to renewables we play a part in providing communities across the globe access to electricity.

C:P1.13.text: Supply Chain Management Doing Business with Powell

C:P2.1.text: Powell Industries | Product Life Extension, Maintenance and Support

C:P2.2.text: Discover how Powell's skilled technicians provide electrical equipment services, switchgear maintenance, field service, and electrical commissioning.

C:P2.3.text: Product Life Extension, Maintenance and Support

C:P2.4.text: Thanks to a team of experienced, highly skilled service technicians and first-class equipment, Powell's testing and commissioning services ensure electrical safety and reliability.

C:P2.5.text: Powell offers a comprehensive line of circuit breakers designed for direct replacement for most major manufacturers. Replacement breakers provide upgraded vacuum interrupting technology as a direct replacement to air magnetic circuit breakers.

C:P2.6.text: Compatible with your existing circuit breakers

C:P2.7.text: Meets or exceeds latest ANSI standards

C:P2.9.text: Upgrading or modifying your existing equipment installation is a cost-effective, time-saving way to increase your system reliability demand and meet system design requirements.

C:P2.10.text: Powell's retrofit and retrofill products provide a cost-effective alternative to complete switchgear replacement when time is critical. Powell Global Services can custom design a breaker cell assembly to be positioned inside of your existing structure, match your control scheme, and custom fit bus work to match your existing installation.

C:P2.11.text: Cost-effective alternative to full equipment replacement

C:P2.13.text: Bus Duct Repair, Replace, Refurbish (RRR) Services

C:P2.14.text: The Powell Repair, Replacement and Refurbishment bus duct program keeps your operation competitive and efficient with the most up-to-date bus technology.

C:P2.15.text: Custom designs to fit to existing equipment

C:P2.16.text: Proper planning and professional execution are key to any successful electrical system start-up. Powell brings you decades of start-up and commissioning project expertise involving both Powell and non-Powell equipment.

C:P2.17.text: Supervision or turnkey start-up services available

C:P2.18.text: LV and MV switchgear and MCC services

C:P2.20.text: Powell has a breaker life extension program that includes extensive teardown, cleaning, and inspection of your circuit breaker; along with installation of the latest technology upgrades.
